scope.question: Which published countermeasures can close each frozen residual side-channel surface, in what dependency order, and with which claims still withheld?
exclusions: This is not a systematic-review claim that no other paper exists.
Paper-level constant-time evidence is not treated as physical power or EM resistance.
Component implementations are not treated as a constant-time full signer.
Reported measurements from different machines and code bases are not compared as one benchmark.

decision.reason: The fixed-width integer substrate and fixed 1421-round half-GCD now execute on the experimental Level-I Sign route; an independent exact-integer proof gives a 644-active-round sufficient bound for the frozen recurrence, and the matched variable-Euclid firmware provides a detected coarse-timer positive control. Two independent host full-Sign runs also retain stable fixed/fixed controls while all four fixed/random pairs differ in both edge and address streams. Two clean source-localization builds map the first differences to a used-limb scan or early-exit integer comparison, and two clean caller-stack builds show both paths share the random-ideal sampler. The next fail-closed gates are to acquire the legacy image as an analog positive control, protect the complete random-ideal-sampling boundary rather than one visible branch, continue localizing later full-Sign structural differences, and repeat the audit on the final Cortex-M33 image before any deployment claim.

primary_literature.title: Simple Power Analysis Attack on SQIsign
primary_literature.review_result: The Cornacchia modular-exponentiation trace exposes a secret-derived ephemeral exponent and the paper connects its recovery to signing-key recovery.
primary_literature.local_reproduction: The paper's three exponent-to-Cornacchia-input formulas recover all 24 frozen public-fixture inputs, the current isolated C Legendre exponent recovers all 16 public-fixture moduli through m=2e+1, and the authors' 54-bit Sage toy backtracking demo reaches its valid-signature marker. None of these runs starts from a physical RP2350 trace or recovers a key from the current C signer.
primary_literature.relevance_to_this_project: It directly motivates the isolated one-pow target and prevents a fixed instruction count from being relabeled as power resistance.
primary_literature.does_not_establish: That the current 521-bit RP2350 experimental route is exploitable or resistant; that requires physical traces and attack scoring on the frozen target.

primary_literature.title: Ready to SQI? Safety First!
primary_literature.review_result: The paper analyzes Cornacchia/half-GCD leakage and proposes a fixed-iteration C-halfgcd plus a randomized two-dimensional lattice alternative.

reported_tradeoffs.c_halfgcd_component: The reported basic C-halfgcd microbenchmark is roughly 250 times the variable-time half-GCD; tighter variants reduce but do not remove that component cost.
reported_tradeoffs.randomized_lattice_component: The reported randomized lattice alternative is roughly five times the compared Cornacchia component.
reported_tradeoffs.whole_sign: The paper reports that whole-signing cost can remain in a similar broad range because other SQIsign work dominates; this is not a target-independent equivalence result.

primary_literature.does_not_establish: A complete constant-time signer or power/EM resistance; the paper explicitly treats SPA/DPA as a separate step after timing regularization.

primary_literature.title: Constant-Time Integer Arithmetic for SQIsign
primary_literature.review_result: It specifies fixed-size GMP-free C arithmetic for SQIsign, including signed operations, Euclidean division, Montgomery-ladder exponentiation, integer square root and dynamic-modulus reduction, and reports Timecop/Valgrind tests.
primary_literature.source_status: No public implementation repository was located in this primary-source review; reproduce the specification or obtain an author source release before code comparison.
primary_literature.does_not_establish: Constant-time quaternion, lattice and protocol composition, analog resistance, or a full constant-time signer.

primary_literature.title: Constant-time lattice reduction in dimension 4
primary_literature.review_result: It gives a fixed-size constant-time dimension-4 LLL/BKZ-2-style reduction and reports ctgrind plus runtime-distribution testing.
primary_literature.reported_tradeoffs: The optimized reduction is reported around 1.5 times the compared non-constant-time reduction, while that component is under about three percent of Release SQIsign in the evaluated setting.
primary_literature.does_not_establish: A direct 32-bit Cortex-M33 port, a GMP-free full signer, constant-time close-vector enumeration, or physical power/EM resistance.

primary_literature.title: Constant-time Quaternion Algorithms for SQIsign
primary_literature.review_result: It regularizes selected HNF, ideal-generator, RepresentInteger and Qlapoti/quaternion routines with fixed iteration counts and branch-free choices.
primary_literature.reported_tradeoffs: The published benchmarks are mixed and input-bound dependent; large fixed RepresentInteger loop bounds can dominate.
primary_literature.does_not_establish: A full constant-time signer. The reviewed repository states that benchmark integer arithmetic uses non-constant-time GMP and that surrounding LLL remains non-constant-time.

reviewed_upstream_snapshots.license_scope: Apache-2.0 for cc/ct-quaternion-NIST2-main; separately review other subtrees
portability_constraints: The reviewed C-halfgcd source still calls GMP-backed ibz comparison, sign, bit-size, shift and multiply operations.
The reviewed norm-equation code retains ordinary C decisions around candidate success and uses non-constant-time lower arithmetic.
Treat the source as an algorithmic reference, not as drop-in Cortex-M33 constant-time evidence.
The repository requires a 64-bit little-endian architecture and GCC.
GMP secure mpn routines are used to size or support arithmetic scratch, and ctgrind is not an ARM-target validation path.
Direct code reuse requires a license decision; a clean-room 32-bit implementation is the default research assumption.
This commit is a literature-comparison anchor, not the dirty compact-sca-ct3 experimental source snapshot.

countermeasure_candidates.description: 521 fixed rounds, always-square-and-multiply, fixed-work Montgomery arithmetic and bounded outer square-root work on the protected calibration route.
required_new_evidence: two independent physical fixed-vs-fixed and fixed-vs-random campaigns
one-, ten- and hundred-trace exponent-recovery attempts
integration and whole-Sign follow-up
countermeasure_candidates.claim_boundary: Removes a known operation-count mechanism; it is neither masking nor a constant-time or constant-power proof.

countermeasure_candidates.description: A Cortex-M33/RADIX32 fixed-width integer substrate modeled on the primitive coverage of ePrint 2025/832 and integrated into the experimental Cornacchia square-root and half-GCD route, but not the whole signer.
preconditions: Level-I operand and result bounds must be proved at every API boundary.
Signed compare, select, bit-size, shift, add/subtract, multiply, division, reduction, pow and sqrt must share one fixed-width contract.
Failure must be fail-closed rather than truncating or retrying silently.
required_new_evidence: differential correctness including alias, boundary and malformed cases
secret-tainted branch/address test and compiler-disassembly gate
Cortex-M33 stack, SRAM, flash and cycle measurements
whole-Sign composition and physical power/EM follow-up
countermeasure_candidates.claim_boundary: Constant control flow and addresses would still not mask secret-dependent data switching.

countermeasure_candidates.description: Fixed-iteration Cornacchia half-GCD following ePrint 2023/807, integrated on the experimental Level-I Sign route with a fixed 1421-round control/address schedule.
preconditions: CM-CTINT-FIXED-WIDTH is present for every primitive invoked by the protected half-GCD.
The conservative fixed iteration bound is independently proved or machine-checked for the exact Level-I C implementation.
The existing quotient/remainder and failure semantics are differentially preserved.
required_new_evidence: two physical campaigns with same-input negative and legacy-variable positive controls
per-round update-mask/state classifier plus whole-Sign timing and physical follow-up
countermeasure_candidates.claim_boundary: The current integration establishes fixed component control/address structure and transcript preservation only. It does not establish constant power, protect Cornacchia inputs/outputs physically, or make the complete signer constant-time.

countermeasure_candidates.description: Randomized two-dimensional lattice reduction proposed in ePrint 2023/807 as an alternative to deterministic half-GCD leakage.
preconditions: RNG freshness and failure behavior are specified and tested.
The output distribution and first-success behavior remain protocol compatible.
Timing resistance is evaluated separately from strict constant-time behavior.
required_new_evidence: post-RNG differential transcripts
distribution and retry-count analysis
target timing and physical attack reruns
countermeasure_candidates.claim_boundary: Randomization can decorrelate a timing trace but is not a fixed-trace or masking proof.

countermeasure_candidates.description: Fixed-iteration HNF, ideal-generator, RepresentInteger and related quaternion algorithms from ePrint 2025/2192.
preconditions: Replace or audit every GMP-backed integer dependency with CM-CTINT-FIXED-WIDTH.
Prove fixed loop bounds and output/failure semantics for Level-I.
Separate Apache-2.0 NIST2 code from differently licensed repository subtrees.
required_new_evidence: clean-room or license-reviewed Cortex-M33 port
full transcript and retry-order differential
resource Pareto and taint/physical evaluation
countermeasure_candidates.claim_boundary: The reviewed source itself acknowledges non-constant-time GMP and LLL dependencies.

preconditions: Reimplement or adapt to 32-bit little-endian fixed limbs without assuming the upstream 64-bit/GMP environment.
Resolve GPL-2.0 reuse before copying code.
Audit close-vector enumeration and all callers outside the reduction module.
required_new_evidence: fixed-width bound proof
differential lattice/output tests
Cortex-M33 stack, SRAM, flash, cycle and branch/address measurements
countermeasure_candidates.claim_boundary: A constant-time lattice submodule does not regularize protocol retries or all lattice consumers.

countermeasure_candidates.description: Fresh masking, exponent/base blinding or state randomization aimed at analog value leakage after control-flow regularization.
preconditions: Specify the algebraic invariant, mask order, refresh schedule and fresh-randomness budget.
Analyze the structured factorization identity left by a recovered blinded exponent and leakage while forming the blind; blind entropy alone is not a security level.
Model sequential register/bus transitions and compiler share placement; secret-independent marginal share distributions alone are insufficient for software masking.

Cover the secret-derived temporary modulus, Montgomery inverse and radix residues, exponent/selector, accumulator prefixes, full multiply/reduce temporaries and Tonelli--Shanks composition; selector-only, exponent-only, context-only, base-only and accumulator-only designs are incomplete.
Prove all fixed-width intermediate bounds and define fail-closed behavior.
Cover every production exponent and status path rather than one diagnostic fixture.
required_new_evidence: formal or exhaustive reduced-domain invariant checks
source-to-final-assembly dependency and share-placement audit for the complete dynamic-modulus Montgomery state
fault and RNG-failure tests
first- and higher-order physical campaigns plus attack-driven scoring
countermeasure_candidates.claim_boundary: No reviewed SQIsign-specific masking or blinding construction has been adopted; ad hoc exponent blinding and partial masking of only the selector, exponent, base, context or accumulator are forbidden.

countermeasure_candidates.description: Compose the integer, Cornacchia, quaternion and lattice countermeasures across every Sign phase and retry boundary.
preconditions: All preceding component work packages pass their structural gates.
The end-to-end operation preserves transcript, RNG consumption, failure and retry semantics.
required_new_evidence: whole-Sign secret-taint branch/address audit
stable negative controls and repeated target timing
segmented power/EM campaigns and key-recovery attempts
RAM, stack, flash and runtime Pareto on the final linked firmware
countermeasure_candidates.claim_boundary: Only this composition stage can support a whole-Sign constant-time claim, and physical resistance remains a separate gate.

work_packages.objective: Implement an auditable fixed-width Level-I/RADIX32 integer kernel before importing any high-level constant-time algorithm.

foundation_evidence.claim_boundary: component-level differential and exact Cortex-M33 structural evidence only; no production, whole-Sign, formal noninterference, masking, power or EM claim

work_packages.completed_slices: Fixed compare/select/sign/bit-length/shift/add/subtract/multiply/square, 1728-round signed truncating division, signed modular reduction, fixed 521-round modular exponentiation, fixed 864-round exact integer square root, and the fixed half-GCD substrate are component-tested; the square-root and half-GCD subset is integrated on the experimental Level-I Cornacchia route.
work_packages.claim_after_pass: constant-control-flow/address integer component on the audited profile only; no analog or whole-Sign resistance

work_packages.objective: Validate residual physical leakage, using the frozen matched legacy firmware as the analog positive control, before comparing randomized alternatives.
work_packages.claim_after_pass: Cornacchia timing/control-flow mitigation only; not a whole-Sign or power/EM claim

work_packages.objective: Port bounded HNF, RepresentInteger and dimension-4 reduction components without importing variable-time GMP or incompatible target assumptions.
Compose every countermeasure, rerun complete Sign leakage screens and perform the preregistered analog and key-recovery campaigns.
work_packages.claim_after_pass: only evidence reviewed at this stage may change the fail-closed deployment decision
